R01.resolution: Numeric numbered positions now accept logical all-missing columns.

R02.resolution: Requested covariates are removed before distance calculation; external frames preserve unrelated same-name positions.

R03.resolution: Fits retain the weighting specification and bootstrap draws replay it, including custom schemes and factor options. Older custom fits without a specification request a rebuild.

R04.resolution: Generated responses are held separately from metadata, protecting .outcome adjustments and grouping columns.

R05.resolution: Named axes are validated and aligned; incompatible named sets are rejected. Unnamed inputs retain positional matching.

R06.resolution: Ordinary Gaussian intervals use residual-df Student t quantiles, matching their displayed tests.

R07.resolution: Tensor directions use log-space products and stable normalization, including 150/400-node and asymmetric analytic controls.

R08.resolution: Landscapes replay weighting, concatenation and markers before counting; bootstrap units are merged sequences. Covariate conflicts and unrepresentable transformed chains produce informative errors. Surface stability measures retain every prepared position, including start markers.

R09.resolution: Nonconstant measures and covariates with identical trimmed endpoints use their full range; both surface plots execute.

R10.resolution: MOGen summary preserves numeric layer/cumulative DOFs above the integer limit.

R11.resolution: Scale-sensitive constant-vector detection preserves normalization of small, nonconstant values.

R12.resolution: Stars-only literal states are explicitly reserved and rejected with documented nestimate_bad_input; ordinary embedded stars remain valid.
